title: Cornflower - Polka Dot Mix - 2x Plug Plants - Easy Grow Native
description:
Cornflower ‘Polka Dot’ (Centaurea cyanus) – 2 Plug Plants – Mixed Colours – Bee-Friendly Annual


 Cornflower ‘Polka Dot’ is a charming mixed-colour selection of Centaurea cyanus, producing an array of classic cornflower shades including blues, pinks, mauves, purples, and whites. Ideal for cottage gardens, cutting patches, and wildlife-friendly borders, these easy, free-flowering annuals are loved by bees and other pollinators.


 Excellent for cutting: long, wiry stems and abundant blooms that last well in the vase and blend beautifully in mixed arrangements.


 Key Details:


  Variety: Cornflower ‘Polka Dot’ (mixed colours)
 

  Quantity: 2 Plug Plants
 

  Type: Annual
 

  Genus: Centaurea cyanus
 

  Flower Colours: Mixed (blue, pink, mauve, purple, white)
 

  Height & Spread: Approx. 60–90 cm tall × 25–30 cm wide
 

  Flowering Period: June – September
 

 Planting and Care Instructions:


  When to Plant Out: July – October, after the risk of frost
 

  Growing Conditions:
  
    Full sun
   

    Prefers poor to moderately fertile, well-drained soil
   

    Use light support or netting in exposed, windy sites
   


  Care Tips:
  
    Water well until established; thereafter water in dry spells
   

    Keep cutting and deadheading to encourage continuous blooming
   


 Why Choose ‘Polka Dot’?
 

 A reliable, easy-to-grow mix that delivers a lively palette of cottage-garden colour, attracts pollinators, and provides a steady supply of beautiful cut flowers.
